SELECT
									object_id,
									s_info_windcode,
									f_prt_enddate,
									crncy_code,
									s_info_stockwindcode,
									f_prt_stkvalue,
									f_prt_stkquantity,
									f_prt_stkvaluetonav,
									f_prt_posstkvalue,
									f_prt_posstkquantity,
									f_prt_posstktonav,
									f_prt_passtkevalue,
									f_prt_passtkquantity,
									f_prt_passtktonav,
									ann_date,
									stock_per,
									float_shr_per,
									opdate,
									opmode
							FROM ${srcdbname}.w_chinamutualfundstockportfolio where f_prt_enddate 
                            between date_format(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(cast(${end_date} as string),'yyyyMMdd')) as date)-interval 6 month ,'yyyyMMdd') and cast(${end_date} as string)
